$ findmnt -no SOURCE /
/dev/sda3
$ lsblk --inverse --json --paths --bytes --output NAME,TYPE,FSTYPE,PKNAME,PARTUUID,SIZE -- /dev/sda3
{"blockdevices":[{"name":"/dev/sda3","type":"part","fstype":"ext4","pkname":"/dev/sda","partuuid":"6a7b8c9d-0e1f-4203-9415-263748596a7b","size":"40793800704",
  "children":[{"name":"/dev/sda","type":"disk","fstype":null,"pkname":null,"partuuid":null,"size":"42949672960"}]}]}
$ blkid -p -o value -s PTTYPE /dev/sda
gpt
$ findmnt -no SOURCE /boot
/dev/sda2
$ lsblk --noheadings --nodeps --paths --output TYPE -- /dev/sda2
part
> /proc/cmdline
